definitions.gloss: beginning of the month; first days of the month
definitions.explanation: The first few days of a calendar month. Commonly used in business contexts for deadlines, reports, and scheduling.

examples.japanese: {月初|げっしょ}にレポートを{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
examples.english: I submit the report at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: {月初|げっしょ}は{会議|かいぎ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many meetings at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{月初|げっしょ}に{目標|もくひょう}を{設定|せってい}して、{月末|げつまつ}に{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}るようにしている。
examples.english: I set goals at the beginning of each month and review them at the end.

notes: The opposite is {月末|げつまつ} (end of the month). Also seen as {月初|げっしょ}め in older usage. Related time expressions: {月初|げっしょ} (beginning of month), {月中|げっちゅう} (middle of month), {月末|げつまつ} (end of month). In business, many tasks have {月初|げっしょ} deadlines: {月初|げっしょ}ミーティング (start-of-month meeting), {月初|げっしょ}{処理|しょり} (beginning-of-month processing).
